policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mexican nationals may visit Panama for tourism or business without a visa.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, short tourism or business visit; entry documentation and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mexican tourists and business visitors may stay in North Macedonia without a visa for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, tourism or business, no more than 90 days; work, residence and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mexican visitors may enter Tunisia without a visa for stays under 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, visitor stay under 90 days; work, residence and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mexican tourists and business visitors may stay in Trinidad and Tobago without a visa for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, tourism or business, no more than 90 days; complete the procedural online arrival/departure card from 17 March 2026.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Kyrgyzstan visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Mexican visitors may enter Kyrgyzstan without a visa for up to 60 days.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, visitor stay up to 60 days; longer stays, work, residence and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free tourism
policies.summary: Mexican ordinary-passport tourists may enter Grenada without a visa for an initial 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport, tourism, initial stay up to 90 days; extension, work, residence and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Mexican tourists may obtain the visitor visa on arrival at Amman International Airport.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican tourist passport; the Allenby/King Hussein Bridge does not issue visas, so use an eligible arrival point or obtain a visa in advance.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Saudi Arabia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The unconditional Mexican tourist baseline is an advance consular visa; conditional third-country-visa arrival routes are separate.
conditions: Obtain the tourist visa from a Saudi embassy or consulate before travel; third-country visa, transit, pilgrimage, work and residence routes are outside the baseline.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visa
policies.summary: Mexican ordinary passport holders use a free single-entry electronic visa for a stay of up to 30 days.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Mexican passport and obtain the single-entry electronic visa before travel; it is valid 180 days and permits up to 30 days.

application.label: Türkiye e-Visa
steps: Apply through Türkiye's official e-Visa service before travel using the ordinary Mexican passport.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Oman electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Ordinary Mexican passport holders can use Oman's electronically issued tourist visa when they do not meet the conditional 14-day exemption.
conditions: Apply for the ordinary tourist visa through Royal Oman Police before travel; the separate 14-day exemption depends on qualifying residence or a third-country visa.

application.label: Royal Oman Police eVisa
steps: Check eligibility and submit the tourist eVisa application through the Royal Oman Police service before travel.

conflicts.explanation: Mexico's current official traveler guidance expressly requires ordinary Mexican passport holders to use Türkiye's free single-entry electronic visa rather than an arrival-issued visa.
